# E.L.L.A. — Embedded Local Logic Agent

> E.L.L.A. is a local-first AI assistant for Windows. All processing runs on-device — no cloud, no subscriptions, no data collection. One-time purchase, yours forever.

E.L.L.A. combines a large language model, 70+ system tools, persistent memory, voice control, and a built-in Safety Directive — without sending a single byte to the cloud.

## Product

- [E.L.L.A. Landing Page](https://ella-agent.de/): Main product page with features, pricing, and launch information
- [E.L.L.A. Safety Directive](https://github.com/AndreZ1971/ella-directive): Open specification with 4 hard prohibitions enforced at architecture level

## Features

- [Kokoro TTS — Local Voice Engine](https://ella-agent.de/): On-device voice synthesis, no cloud dependency
- [Ollama Integration](https://ella-agent.de/): Local LLM inference via Gemma, Llama, Mistral

## Optional

- [E.L.L.A. on GitHub](https://github.com/AndreZ1971): Source repositories and open specifications
